If {groupABCPercentage}% like all three, find the percentage who like at least one.

If {groupABCPercentage}% speak all three, find the percentage who speak at least one.

PCT-QL-011.template: A number was to be divided by {correctDivisor}, but it was divided by {wrongDivisor}. Find the percentage error.

PCT-QL-014.template: Commission is {baseCommissionRate}% up to Rs. {thresholdAmount} and {bonusCommissionRate}% above it. Find commission on sales of Rs. {salesAmount}.

PCT-QL-020.template: Brokerage is charged at {baseChargeRate}% up to {thresholdAmount} and {extraChargeRate}% above it. Find the total brokerage on {usageAmount}.

PCT-QL-021.template: Incentive is paid at {baseChargeRate}% up to {thresholdAmount} and {extraChargeRate}% on the remaining amount. Find the total incentive on {usageAmount}.

PCT-QL-050.template: Income tax is {tier1Rate}% up to Rs. {tier1Limit}, {tier2Rate}% from Rs. {tier1Limit} to Rs. {tier2Limit}, and {tier3Rate}% above Rs. {tier2Limit}. Find the total tax on an income of Rs. {totalBase}.

PCT-QL-054.template: A broker charges {tier1Rate}% on deals up to Rs. {tier1Limit} and {tier2Rate}% on any amount above it. If his total brokerage is Rs. {totalResult}, find the deal value.

PCT-QL-055.template: Tax is {tier1Rate}% up to Rs. {tier1Limit} and {tier2Rate}% above it. If the total tax paid is Rs. {totalResult}, find the gross amount.
